label: D2 arrival at S2 after a rewarded trial (esp. coming from S1), early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only when the reward input at this trial D1 was 1 (prev_reward == 1, ~100% recall); never on D1/GO or after unrewarded trials. Within that, it prefers reaching S2 (87% of mass) and especially reaching S2 right after a trial that ended in S1 (a state change following reward), and is confined to the first ~50-60 trials of the episode (rate falls to ~0 after trial 60) and high-value steps. The largest activations are switches to a2 -> S2 after a rewarded run of a1 -> S1 while S1 is still the good state. All variables are observed at D2. The predicate captures ~83% of activation mass but precision is only ~0.2: most qualifying steps are inactive, so the unit is a sparse, graded signal on top of this context, not a clean detector.
